newsitem.title: USA: Philip Morris up as momentum continues.
newsitem.headline: Philip Morris up as momentum continues.

text.p: Philip Morris Cos Inc rose on Tuesday as investors were attracted by the prospect of higher earnings, analysts said.
The company's stock rose two points to 116-1/4 in early trade. Shares traded were 1.5 million, putting Philip Morris among volume leaders.
"In a market where investors are concerned about slow corporate earnings growth and high valuations, this is an obvious place to turn," said Anton Brenner, an analyst at UBS Securities.

Philip Morris shares rose more than four points on Monday after Goldman Sachs analyst Marc Cohen raised his 12-month price target for the stock to $135 from $125. He cited strong U.S. sales, a likely stock split and repurchase extension and an easing of legal pressure on the tobacco industry as reasons for the increase.
Philip Morris stock "has been strong for a week and it gained momentum yesterday and (that's) carrying it forward," Cohen said.
